msg: Hi! I'm Aoife, an Irish backpacker travelling on a tight budget. I'm in Cartagena for 3 more days and I've been Open Water certified since 2023. What's the cheapest way to get a dive in?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Since you’re Open Water certified and in Cartagena, the cheapest option for a dive is *Fun Dives — 2 dives in one day*. It includes gear, lunch, and the round-trip boat to the Rosario Islands. The online price is below.

You can choose a date and book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Just me. Hmm, 178 USD is a lot for my budget. Is there any discount, or anything cheaper, like a single dive?
reply:
From Cartagena, the minimum is two dives; a single dive is only available if you’re already on the Rosario Islands, or in exceptional cases arranged through an advisor. The online discount is already included in the price you saw. There’s also a 5% discount if you bring your complete dive gear (regulator, BCD, wetsuit, mask and fins); it doesn’t apply if you bring only some of it.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD

Groups of 5 or more get a 10% group discount, on top of the 10% online discount, on recreational diving, the mini-course and snorkeling (not on PADI courses); it is not applied automatically: it has to be requested from the team before paying.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather do more dives, there are *packages* of 3 or more; just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since your last dive?

msg: My last dive was about a year ago. I don't have my own gear, so that doesn't help. Honestly I think it's still too much for me, I'll probably skip it and spend on something else. Thanks anyway for the info!
reply: No worries at all, Aoife — I understand. Thanks for considering diving with us, and I hope you have a wonderful time in Cartagena! If you change your mind while you’re here, I’d be happy to help you look at the options.
